title: Image prompt - Substation
promptText:
Create a photorealistic wide-angle photograph of a modern high-voltage electrical substation in Maharashtra at golden hour.

Include: steel gantries, transformers, insulator strings, gravel yard, chain-link perimeter, distant hills, overcast-to-sunset sky.

Style: documentary photojournalism, natural colour, shallow atmospheric haze, no cinematic neon glow.

Strict exclusions:
- No readable logos, board names, or number plates
- No recognisable faces of real officials
- No text overlays, watermarks, or UI chrome
- No unsafe worker poses near live equipment
- No fictional city names

Composition: horizontal 16:9, suitable for a training slide or public awareness banner about grid infrastructure (not a crisis scene).
